dtNote: Effective dt per N is gap-seeded: dtEff = min(DT, d_min^2/80). See row.dt for actual dt used (imp514d fix). Additionally, currentDt is capped to mg^2/12 at each step to prevent overshoot as gap decays (imp514f fix).

subGaps.description: zeros data blocker: zeros-to-1e6.js has 100K entries; N>100K needs zeros2..zerosK. Run this script with --download to fetch additional Odlyzko batches. zeros6 may also be a combined 2M-zero file (~35 MB) at the same base URL.

compute feasibility: Float64 RK4 in Node.js handles N up to ~250K-400K (minutes to hours). N=600K-1M requires C/Rust backend (Arb, CAPD, or custom). This script cannot fully close imp-514 for N=1M without native code.

certification: Float64 RK4 gives t_c central value without error bars. Interval arithmetic (interval-dyson-integrator.mjs) is certified but returns budget-exhausted for N>100K. Closing imp-514 with certified bounds at N=1M requires a native Arb/CAPD backend.

step-size overshoot at large N: FIXED. dtEff = min(DT, d_min^2/80) is seeded from the initial minimum gap d_min so the first RK4 step cannot overshoot the nearest-pair collapse time T_pair ~ d_min^2/8.

overshoot detector anchoring bug: FIXED. ADAPT_THRESH is now 3 * maxDt (the restored full DT), not 3 * dtEff (the tiny gap-seeded initial step). The threshold now tracks the actual stride in use so adaptive halving triggers correctly for second close encounters at the restored stride.

gap-safe step cap: FIXED. After the adaptive/restore block, currentDt is now capped to mg^2/12 (2/3 of the pairwise collapse time t_c_pair = mg^2/8). Without this cap, a restored maxDt could overshoot the collision once the gap had decayed to where t_c_pair << maxDt (e.g. at N=10K: after step 0 the gap drops from 0.0377 to ~0.025, giving t_c_pair ~ 7.8e-5 << DT=1e-4, and the next full-maxDt step overshoots). With the cap, gap^2 shrinks by 1/3 per step, converging in ~30-40 steps. The previous N=10K validation result t_c=0.0003 (3 full-maxDt steps) was an overshoot artifact from this bug; the cache has been cleared for re-generation with the corrected harness.

usageNote: Import these rows into dyson-ladder-measured.js to replace PROJECTED_ROWS at matching N. Only rows with source="measured-float64-rk4" and reason="gap-nonpositive" carry a meaningful collision time. Budget-exhausted rows report t_c as a lower bound. Re-run with: node scripts/compute-dyson-ladder-extended.mjs --download --max-n 250000
